description: This file contains USB Mass Storage Device (MSD) configuration for a hardware layer, including USB descriptors, endpoint settings, and event handling for a mass storage device implemented using the ChibiOS RTOS.

methods.name: get_descriptor
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of USB descriptors based on the request type, returning appropriate device, configuration, or string descriptors.

methods.name: usb_event
methods.description: Callback function handling various USB driver events such as reset, configured, suspend, etc.
